issues.problem: Misuse 1 (花に毎朝水を差している) was not clearly wrong: 水を差す has a real literal use (adding water to a pot or a drink), and the 'why' line falsely said it is only used figuratively.
issues.action: Replaced it with a clear misuse: using it to mean livening up a party (誕生日会で歌を歌って、場に水を差した), with a reason that states the opposite meaning.

issues.problem: The story source, 'folk legend of the sacrificial maiden', suggested one particular named legend. What tradition actually gives is a general folk belief about human sacrifice.
issues.action: Changed the source to 'Japanese folk belief about human sacrifice (人身御供) demanded by a god'. The story text already hedges ('as the expression is traditionally explained'), so it was kept.
